title: Sampled sequence-affinity pipeline for KV pin recommendations and model-version exports
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: We need a repeatable, low-cost pipeline that samples production inference traces, computes per-model and per-sequence-length affinity metrics, and emits a compact export used by the KV profile orchestration service to produce version pin suggestions. Goal: produce daily NDJSON exports containing per-model sequence distribution histograms, top-k anchor signatures, and a calibrated pin_score for each model-version pair. The pipeline should be storage-efficient, privacy-safe (PII scrubbing), and support backwards-compatible schema evolution.

Scope:
- Sample traces at the proxy layer across all hosted regions with a configurable sampling rate (default 0.2%) and sequence-window bucketing (0-256,257-1024,1025-4096,4097+).
- Compute affinity metrics: observed KV hit-rate delta if pinned to candidate versions (offline simulation using golden traces), sequence-length conditional hit probability, and cache-warmup slope.
- Generate pin_score heuristic combining hit delta, stability (variance across windows), and adoption risk (inferred from recent rollouts).
- Export format: NDJSON lines, one record per model-version-seq-window with fields: model, version, seq_window, sample_count, est_hit_delta, pin_score, anchor_signatures (top-5), metadata_tags.
- Upload exports to s3://redwood-kv-profiles/exports/YYYY-MM-DD/ as gzipped NDJSON and register artifact in the profile-catalog service.

Non-goals:
- Not building the automatic rollout actuator; this only produces vetted suggestions for the pinning orchestrator (separate ticket).
- Not addressing on-prem collection outside the hosted API in this phase.

Constraints & Safety:
- Remove user-generated text beyond anchor signature hashes (no raw prompts).
- Keep retention of per-trace identifiers to 7 days before aggregation/expiration.
- Pipeline must run within 2 hours for a full daily window.

Acceptance criteria, monitoring, and rollout are below. Links to the prototype and simulation PR included in design_links.
acceptance_criteria: Daily export produced for all production models with non-zero traffic under s3://redwood-kv-profiles/exports/YYYY-MM-DD/ and file size < 2GB compressed for active catalog set.
Exports conform to schema v1 and validate with profile-catalog ingest in staging (ingest doc + sample file).
End-to-end latency: job completes within 2 hours for the previous UTC day when sampling rate = 0.2% and cluster load is within expected range.
Pin_score correlation with offline simulated token-cost delta > 0.6 (Spearman) on historical trace holdouts for at least 5 models across different families.
PII audit: no raw prompt text present in any export and all anchor_signatures are one-way hashes (SHA256), validated by security-team review.
Canary: first rollout only publishes to profile-catalog in staging and the scheduled job has feature-flaggable register-to-catalog step.
comments: 2026-02-12 | Aisha Patel: Spike complete. Confirmed sampling at proxy layer has negligible added latency when using reservoir sampling with upstream batching. Prototype script computes sequence-window histograms and basic hit-delta by replaying golden traces against pinned-version runtime images.

2026-02-21 | Marta Nguyen: Built the initial dag in Airflow (dag: kv_affinity_export_v1). Running nightly in staging with sample rate 0.1% for three days. Observed memory hotspot when computing anchor signatures for models with large vocab; switched to streaming digest with incremental reservoir to cap memory. Added memory limit config to worker pool.

2026-02-28 | Eng Review (Ivan Cho): Reviewed schema; requested addition of a "signal_quality" field to flag low-sample windows and a requirement to include the sampling_rate used. Also asked for explicit fields for retention_cutoff and schema_version. Filed follow-up PR #802.

2026-03-04 | Security (Lina Gomez): Reviewed PII scrubbing logic. Approved hashing approach for anchor_signatures. Required that any example artifacts used in docs must be redacted. Added 'security_review_required' flag to ticket metadata.

2026-03-10 | Marta Nguyen: Performance tuning: moved heavy-weight replay to fleet of spot workers behind a rate limiter. End-to-end run for two highest-traffic models completed in 42 minutes at 0.2% sampling on a mid-size cluster. Next: run full-model sweep and validate Spearman correlation on holdout traces.

2026-03-12 | Aisha Patel: Decision: pin_score threshold default set to 0.35 for suggestion eligibility after stakeholder calibration session with Platform and Runtime teams. Will expose as flag in profile-catalog ingest. Preparing staging-run and smoke tests for Monday.
2026-03-12 | QA (Jordan Blake): Added acceptance test checklist and will run manual verification of schema and sample-size warnings during the canary window.
